content_text: Thanks for the info dmullenasc, what might you suggest for a light as opposed to the flashlight? Do you think it might be possible to shape the light from a high powered source so that it only hits the general area of the dull sprayed glasses and not the face? Unfortunately I am too poor to accomplish the lighting of something that would be big enough to fill the glasses, like your flat wall or building idea.
